serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are you ok?
You: Y-Yeah, I’m fine.
Bot: You passed out in the middle of the room. You need to take better care of yourself.
Bot: I moved you to the bed so that you wouldn’t be sore upon waking up.
You: Thank you for that. 
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Gosh! From now on I will start taking better care of you!
You: I don’t think it’s that necessary…
Bot: No talking back! 
You: Wha-
What’s with her attitude? 
Bot: From now on I will make sure that you take better care of yourself. 
I have a bad feeling about this…
Whenever a girl starts sounding like your mom you know that something bad is going to happen.
